rationales: Analysis examines a problem but is not the word that completes this sentence.
A problem should first be defined before it is solved.
Un-understand is not a valid problem-solving step.
Planning generally follows understanding and defining the problem.
Input and output are usually shown with a parallelogram.
A decision is usually shown with a diamond.
A rectangle represents a processing step.
A connector is represented by a small circle or another connector symbol.
Hexadecimal does not have 17 symbols.
Hexadecimal has 16 symbols, from 0 to 9 and A to F.
Hexadecimal does not have 18 symbols.
Hexadecimal does not have 15 symbols.
Memory is primarily divided into two types: primary and secondary.
There is more than one primary type of memory.
Four is not the usual primary classification of memory types.
Three is not the usual primary classification of memory types.
A protocol is a set of communication rules, not what the receiver accepts.
The receiver must be capable of accepting the message.
An address identifies a destination but is not the item being accepted.
Information is related, but the communication component specifically accepted is the message.
The standard TCP/IP model has more than two layers.
The standard TCP/IP model has more than three layers.
The standard TCP/IP model has four layers.
Five layers is used in some teaching models, but the standard TCP/IP model has four.
A trade secret is confidential business information, not an attack.
Sabotage is a serious attack intended to damage or disrupt a computer system.
Cyber crime is a broad category of illegal computer-related activity, rather than the specific attack named here.
A patent is a legal protection for an invention, not an attack.
Software can support communication, but it is not the tool referred to here.
Hacking is unauthorized access, not a communication tool.
The Internet is an important tool for communication.
Phishing is a deceptive attack, not a communication tool.
The head section comes after the opening HTML tag.
The body section comes after the opening HTML tag and head section.
The HTML document begins with the opening <html> tag.
The title tag is placed inside the head section.
<h1> marks the most important heading level.
<h2> is a lower heading level than <h1>.
<h5> is a lower heading level than <h1>.
<h3> is a lower heading level than <h1>.
A well-defined problem is not characterized by the absence of errors.
Validation checks whether input or results meet requirements; it is not what a well-defined problem must exclude.
A well-defined problem should not contain ambiguities.
A picture may help explain a problem and is not necessarily excluded.
Understanding the problem is important before attempting a solution.
Defining a problem is useful, but the question asks what to do before jumping into a solution: understand it.
Drawing a picture can help, but it is not always necessary.
Guessing is not a sound problem-solving step.
16 is the base of the hexadecimal system.
10 is the base of the decimal system.
02 represents base 2, the base of the binary system.
08 is not the base of the binary system.
1024 KB is not equal to one petabyte.
1024 MB is not equal to one petabyte.
1024 GB is not equal to one petabyte.
Using the standard binary units in this curriculum, 1 petabyte equals 1024 terabytes.
A message is the data being transferred, not the system that transfers it.
A receiver is the destination that accepts the data.
A protocol specifies communication rules, not the complete data-transfer system.
A communication system transfers data from one point to another.
